summary: The evidence clearly does not support that GLP-1 drugs have no side effects. Nausea, vomiting, and gastrointestinal issues are well-documented. Rare but serious risks include pancreatitis and thyroid concerns.

sources.title: FDA Requests Removal of Suicidal Behavior and Ideation Warning ...
sources.quote: FDA is requesting that drug application holders remove information regarding the risk of suicidal ideation and behavior (SI/B) from the labeling of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) medications...This action follows a comprehensive FDA review that found no increased risk of SI/B associated with the use of GLP-1 RA medications.
sources.credibility_reason: Official FDA government source (.gov) with direct regulatory authority over drug safety communications, presenting documented review findings and policy decisions.
